metadata.title: OncologyBench
metadata.methodology: Strict pass rate is the share of all attempt slots that pass in the supplied export: both analytical tasks (L1) and the final decision (L3) receive full marks. Only the selected 25 evaluations are included, with three attempts per evaluation and configuration. Nine of the 25 gained a new decision rubric and were re-graded against it; their L3 scores and pass flags come from that re-grade, and the other sixteen keep their original grades. The two Meta Muse configurations, Mistral Large 4.0 Preview and Mercury 3 ran on copy versions of the selected evaluations that are byte-identical to the originals, and were graded by the same pipeline. Refusals and the four timed-out slots remain in the denominator. Timeouts are reported separately from failure. The 95% interval is a Wilson score interval on the pooled attempt slots (75 per configuration). Task and decision scores are means of available scores; missing scores are omitted, not zero-filled. Multi-label skill filters count each evaluation once.
